subject: CAIQ control narratives and crosswalk for Zenith Bank
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@zenithbank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@zenithbank.com
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk + control narratives request

Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re well. As part of our vendor security review we need an annotated CAIQ crosswalk and short control narratives for a subset of CCM controls relevant to inference (data residency, key management, runtime telemetry, multi-tenant isolation). Could you provide:  
- A CAIQ mapping file with our scope columns pre-filled (we scope: hosted API + Dedicated reservation)
- Short (1-2 paragraph) narratives per control explaining how Redwood meets the control and where the artifact lives
- Representative log/telemetry snippets for runtime controls (anonymized is fine)

Target: review by our InfoSec team on Sept 7. Let us know if that timeline works and any format preferences.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Zenith Bank

Attachment: Zenith_Risk_RFI_20260828.pdf (referenced)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@zenithbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk + control narratives request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can deliver an annotated CAIQ and a short control narrative pack by EOD Sept 4 to give your team time to review ahead of the 7th.

Plan:
- Kimberly will do the CAIQ mapping and artifact pointers for infra/ops controls.
- Priyom will draft the control narratives for runtime/caching/telemetry and pull anonymized snippets.
- I’ll assemble the package and upload to a shared Drive + DocuSign acknowledgement if you need a signature.

Would you like the crosswalk as an Excel with separate tabs per control domain, or a single sheet? We typically deliver both but can compress to one sheet for smaller teams.

-Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

> On 2026-09-03 Olivia Chen wrote:
> > As part of our vendor security review...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk + control narratives request

Chloe — starting the mapping now. Quick notes / assumptions I made and will call out in the crosswalk:
- Scope: Hosted API (multi-tenant) + Dedicated (customer-reserved pools). I flagged controls where evidence differs by mode (e.g., tenant isolation vs. dedicated VPC).
- KeyMgmt: For private customers we reference customer KMS integrations (KMS/HSM). Hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys with KM rotation policy documented in the artifact.
- Telemetry: runtime telemetry is retained in our observability pipeline (retention windows vary by plan). I will include example retrieval paths (stacktrace -> tracing id -> storage bucket).

Attachments I’m preparing:
- Attachment: Zenith-CAIQ-annotated-crosswalk-20260903.xlsx (single-sheet crosswalk + domain tabs)
- Attachment: control-narratives-zenithbank.pdf (1-2 paragraph narratives per requested control)

I’ll drop the files to Chloe’s shared folder for a final pass.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk + control narratives request

Quick clarifying Qs for the telemetry snippets I’ll include:
1) Do we need full request traces or are prefix/KV-cache snapshots sufficient? Customer asked specifically about KV cache eviction and cache-seeding telemetry.
2) For anonymization: strip tenant ids and replace with stable pseudonyms (we often use ZENITH-EXAMPLE-01). Is that acceptable to Zenith’s InfoSec?

If the answer is: prefix/KV snapshots + pseudonyms, I’ll assemble 3 short snippets (sampling, eviction event, cache-warm hit) and annotate each with the relevant CCM/CAIQ control mapping.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. Applied ML Engineer (Inference)
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@zenithbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, procurement@zenithbank.com
Date: 2026-09-04T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ control narratives and crosswalk for Zenith Bank

Hi Olivia — attached is the consolidated package for your review. Contents: 
- Zenith-CAIQ-annotated-crosswalk-20260903.xlsx (single-sheet crosswalk with tabs for Data Security, Cryptography, Runtime Observability, and Tenant Isolation)
- control-narratives-zenithbank.pdf (short narratives + artifact references and owner contact)
- runtime-telemetry-snippets-zenith.txt (anonymized examples: cache-seed, eviction, trace-id lookup)

We also added a short appendix mapping our artifact names to the CAIQ questions (so your auditors can request specific artifacts directly). If everything looks good we can provide a DocuSign acknowledgement for your records: https://docusign.com/abc123/zenith-caiq-ack

Next steps I propose:
- Your team reviews by Sept 7 and flags any gaps or requests for deeper artifacts.
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough on Sept 8 to go through a few controls live (Telemetry, KeyMgmt, Dedicated isolation).

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0194

Attachments: Zenith-CAIQ-annotated-crosswalk-20260903.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), control-narratives-zenithbank.pdf (application/pdf), runtime-telemetry-snippets-zenith.txt (text/plain)
